upstream.description: Vendored upstream agent-sandbox controller (apiGroup agents.x-k8s.io). Bundled into the chart so a single `helm install` brings up the whole platform. NOTE: upstream.deploy gates only the controller (Deployment/RBAC/Services); the agents.x-k8s.io CRDs live in chart/crds/ and are always applied on `helm install` regardless of this flag. The chart default (values.yaml) sets upstream.deploy=true; set it false when the controller is already installed cluster-wide (and pass --skip-crds if the CRDs are also present).

deploy.description: true (chart default) installs the upstream controller Deployment, RBAC and Services (rendered by templates/upstream/upstream.yaml). The agents.x-k8s.io CRDs live in chart/crds/ and are always applied by `helm install` regardless of this flag. false skips the controller (use when it is already installed cluster-wide; also pass --skip-crds if the CRDs are already present).

imageRegistry.description: Registry prefix, e.g. ghcr.io (prod). Empty => bare image names (KIND/CI, loaded into the node).

imageOwner.description: Image owner/namespace. CI sets this from github.repository_owner.

imagePullPolicy.description: Kubernetes imagePullPolicy. KIND uses Never (images pre-loaded); prod uses IfNotPresent.

imagePullSecrets.description: Optional Kubernetes imagePullSecrets (LocalObjectReference list). Attached to broker, router and runtime pod specs when non-empty.

replicas.description: Broker Deployment replicas. 1 = single broker (default; leader election is a no-op, the sole broker always reaps). Set >1 for HA — a coordination.k8s.io Lease ensures only the elected replica runs the reaper.

sharedSecret.description: Shared secret for broker auth. Empty => auto-generate a random 48-char secret on first install (stable across upgrades via Helm lookup). The legacy dev placeholder is forbidden.

s3.description: S3-tiered cold tier (issue #52). Set broker.persistentMode=s3-tiered + enabled=true to eliminate PVCs (hot tier=emptyDir, cold tier=S3). Off by default; default install unchanged.

enabled.description: Gate the whole feature (and the broker boot guard that rejects s3-tiered without it).

endpoint.description: Bring-your-own S3-compatible URL (https://...). Empty allowed when enabled=false.

region.description: S3 region (some MinIO/R2 setups ignore it).

credentialsSecret.description: Secret (system ns) with access-key-id + secret-access-key. Bring-your-own (chart references, does not create).

retentionDays.description: Per-session lifetime (R2): object Expires = now + retentionDays.

sse.description: Server-side encryption at rest (D9). AES256=SSE-S3 (default, AWS S3); empty disables SSE for stores without a KMS/SSE backend (dev MinIO).

periodicSyncInterval.description: R1: snapshot running sessions every N seconds.

sizeLimit.description: Hot-tier emptyDir sizeLimit + runtime MAX_WORKSPACE_BYTES (default 2Gi, D2/D9).

tmpfs.description: true => /workspace is tmpfs (Memory) instead of disk-backed emptyDir.

reaperPollSeconds.description: Reaper loop interval when s3 is enabled (lower = faster offload-on-reap; default 60).

runtimeClassName.description: gVisor runtime class; empty => field omitted (runc, for KIND e2e).

uid.description: Non-root UID the sandbox runs as.

monitoring.description: Observability: Prometheus scrape (ServiceMonitor/PodMonitor) + OpenTelemetry traces (bring-your-own collector). All off by default.

prometheus.description: monitoring.coreos.com ServiceMonitor + PodMonitor (requires the prometheus-operator CRDs).

enabled.description: Render ServiceMonitor (broker) + PodMonitor (runtime). Off by default so CRD-less clusters install cleanly.

scrapeTimeout.description: Scrape timeout (Prometheus duration). Must be < interval to avoid flapping. Default 30s.

otlp.description: OTLP endpoint for broker + runtime traces (OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT). Empty => tracing disabled (soft no-op).

endpoint.description: OTLP/HTTP base endpoint, e.g. http://collector:4318. Empty disables tracing.

otelCollector.description: Optional bundled opentelemetry-collector subchart (off by default). Values pass through to the upstream chart; 'enabled' gates its deployment.

enabled.description: Deploy the bundled opentelemetry-collector subchart and default monitoring.otlp.endpoint to it.
